=== clauses/match/Match1.feature [1]
query
      MATCH (n)
      RETURN n
expect bag
      | n |
side-effects none

=== clauses/match/Match1.feature [2]
setup
      CREATE (:A), (:B {name: 'b'}), ({name: 'c'})
query
      MATCH (n)
      RETURN n
expect bag
      | n                |
      | (:A)             |
      | (:B {name: 'b'}) |
      | ({name: 'c'})    |
side-effects none

=== clauses/match/Match1.feature [3]
setup
      CREATE (:A:B:C), (:A:B), (:A:C), (:B:C),
             (:A), (:B), (:C),
             ({name: ':A:B:C'}), ({abc: 'abc'}), ()
query
      MATCH (a:A:B)
      RETURN a
expect bag
      | a        |
      | (:A:B)   |
      | (:A:B:C) |
side-effects none

=== clauses/match/Match1.feature [4]
setup
      CREATE ({name: 'bar'}), ({name: 'monkey'}), ({firstname: 'bar'})
query
      MATCH (n {name: 'bar'})
      RETURN n
expect bag
      | n               |
      | ({name: 'bar'}) |
side-effects none

=== clauses/match/Match1.feature [5]
setup
      CREATE ({num: 1}),
        ({num: 2}),
        ({num: 3})
query
      MATCH (n), (m)
      RETURN n.num AS n, m.num AS m
expect bag
      | n | m |
      | 1 | 1 |
      | 1 | 2 |
      | 1 | 3 |
      | 2 | 1 |
      | 2 | 2 |
      | 2 | 3 |
      | 3 | 3 |
      | 3 | 1 |
      | 3 | 2 |
side-effects none

=== clauses/match/Match1.feature [6]
query

      RETURN n
expect compile-error SyntaxError InvalidParameterUse
side-effects none

=== clauses/match/Match3.feature [17]

=== clauses/match/Match3.feature [23]
setup
      CREATE (a:A), (b:B), (c:C)
      CREATE (a)-[:T]->(b),
             (a)-[:T]->(c)
query
      MATCH (a)-->(b)
      MATCH (c)-->(d)
      RETURN a, b, c, d
expect bag
      | a    | b    | c    | d    |
      | (:A) | (:B) | (:A) | (:B) |
      | (:A) | (:B) | (:A) | (:C) |
      | (:A) | (:C) | (:A) | (:B) |
      | (:A) | (:C) | (:A) | (:C) |
side-effects none

=== clauses/match/Match3.feature [29]

      RETURN r

=== clauses/match/Match4.feature [3]
setup
      CREATE (a {name: 'A'}), (b {name: 'B'}),
             (c {name: 'C'}), ({name: 'D'}),
             ({name: 'E'})
      CREATE (a)-[:CONTAINS]->(b),
             (b)-[:FRIEND]->(c)
query
      MATCH (a {name: 'A'})-[:CONTAINS*0..1]->(b)-[:FRIEND*0..1]->(c)
      RETURN a, b, c
expect bag
      | a             | b             | c             |
      | ({name: 'A'}) | ({name: 'A'}) | ({name: 'A'}) |
      | ({name: 'A'}) | ({name: 'B'}) | ({name: 'B'}) |
      | ({name: 'A'}) | ({name: 'B'}) | ({name: 'C'}) |
side-effects none

=== clauses/match-where/MatchWhere6.feature [2]
setup
      CREATE (s:Single), (a:A {num: 42}),
             (b:B {num: 46}), (c:C)
      CREATE (s)-[:REL]->(a),
             (s)-[:REL]->(b),
             (a)-[:REL]->(c),
             (b)-[:LOOP]->(b)

      WHERE m:NonExistent
      RETURN r

      | null |
side-effects none

=== clauses/match-where/MatchWhere6.feature [4]
setup
      CREATE (a), (b {name: 'Mark'})
      CREATE (a)-[:T]->(b)
query
      MATCH (n)-->(x0)
      OPTIONAL MATCH (x0)-->(x1)
      WHERE x1.name = 'bar'
      RETURN x0.name
expect bag
      | x0.name |
      | 'Mark'  |
side-effects none

=== clauses/with/With6.feature [1]
setup
      CREATE ({name: 'A'}),
             ({name: 'A'}),
             ({name: 'B'})
query
      MATCH (a)
      WITH a.name AS name, count(*) AS relCount
      RETURN name, relCount
expect bag
      | name | relCount |
      | 'A'  | 2        |
      | 'B'  | 1        |
side-effects none

=== clauses/with/With6.feature [2]
setup
      CREATE ()-[:T1]->(:X),
             ()-[:T2]->(:X),
             ()-[:T3]->()
query
      MATCH ()-[r1]->(:X)
      WITH r1 AS r2, count(*) AS c
      MATCH ()-[r2]->()
      RETURN r2 AS rel
expect bag
      | rel   |
      | [:T1] |
      | [:T2] |
side-effects none

=== clauses/with/With6.feature [3]
setup
      CREATE ()-[:T1]->(:X),
             ()-[:T2]->(:X),
             ()-[:T3]->()
query
      MATCH (a)-[r1]->(b:X)
      WITH a, r1 AS r2, b, count(*) AS c
      MATCH (a)-[r2]->(b)
      RETURN r2 AS rel
expect bag
      | rel   |
      | [:T1] |
      | [:T2] |
side-effects none

=== clauses/with/With6.feature [4]
expect reject-profile

  MATCH p = ()-[*]->()
  WITH count(*) AS count, p AS p
  RETURN nodes(p) AS nodes

=== clauses/with/With6.feature [6]

  WITH me.age AS age, you

=== expressions/aggregation/Aggregation5.feature [1]
setup
      CREATE ()
query
      MATCH (n)
      OPTIONAL MATCH (n)-[:NOT_EXIST]->(x)
      RETURN n, collect(x)
expect bag
      | n  | collect(x) |
      | () | []         |
side-effects none

=== expressions/aggregation/Aggregation5.feature [2]
setup
      CREATE (:DoesExist {num: 42})
      CREATE (:DoesExist {num: 43})
      CREATE (:DoesExist {num: 44})
query
      OPTIONAL MATCH (f:DoesExist)
      OPTIONAL MATCH (n:DoesNotExist)
      RETURN collect(DISTINCT n.num) AS a, collect(DISTINCT f.num) AS b
expect bag-lists-unordered
      | a  | b            |
      | [] | [42, 43, 44] |
side-effects none

=== expressions/boolean/Boolean1.feature [1]
query
      RETURN true AND true AS tt,
             true AND false AS tf,
             true AND null AS tn,
             false AND true AS ft,
             false AND false AS ff,
             false AND null AS fn,
             null AND true AS nt,
             null AND false AS nf,
             null AND null AS nn
expect bag
      | tt   | tf    | tn   | ft    | ff    | fn    | nt   | nf    | nn   |
      | true | false | null | false | false | false | null | false | null |
side-effects none

=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [1]
setup
      CREATE ({exists: 42})
query
      MATCH (n)
      RETURN n.missing IS NULL,
             n.exists IS NULL
expect bag
      | n.missing IS NULL | n.exists IS NULL |
      | true              | false            |
side-effects none

=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [2]
setup
      CREATE ({exists: 42})
query
      OPTIONAL MATCH (n)
      RETURN n.missing IS NULL,
             n.exists IS NULL
expect bag
      | n.missing IS NULL | n.exists IS NULL |
      | true              | false            |
side-effects none

=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [3]
query
      OPTIONAL MATCH (n)
      RETURN n.missing IS NULL
expect bag
      | n.missing IS NULL |
      | true              |
side-effects none

=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [4]
query
      RETURN null IS NULL AS value
expect bag
      | value |
      | true  |
side-effects none

=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 1
expect reject-profile
query
  WITH {name: 'Mats', name2: 'Pontus'} AS map
  RETURN map.name IS NULL AS result
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 2
expect reject-profile
query
  WITH {name: 'Mats', name2: 'Pontus'} AS map
  RETURN map.name2 IS NULL AS result
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 3
expect reject-profile
query
  WITH {name: 'Mats', name2: null} AS map
  RETURN map.name IS NULL AS result
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 4
expect reject-profile
query
  WITH {name: 'Mats', name2: null} AS map
  RETURN map.name2 IS NULL AS result
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 5
expect reject-profile
query
  WITH {name: null} AS map
  RETURN map.name IS NULL AS result
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 6
expect reject-profile
query
  WITH {name: null, name2: null} AS map
  RETURN map.name IS NULL AS result
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 7
expect reject-profile
query
  WITH {name: null, name2: null} AS map
  RETURN map.name2 IS NULL AS result
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 8
expect reject-profile
query
  WITH {notName: null, notName2: null} AS map
  RETURN map.name IS NULL AS result
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 9
expect reject-profile
query
  WITH {notName: 0, notName2: null} AS map
  RETURN map.name IS NULL AS result
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 10
expect reject-profile
query
  WITH {notName: 0} AS map
  RETURN map.name IS NULL AS result
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 11
expect reject-profile
query
  WITH {} AS map
  RETURN map.name IS NULL AS result
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [5] example 12
expect local-example
query
  WITH null AS map
  RETURN map.name IS NULL AS result
result true
=== expressions/null/Null1.feature [6]
setup
      CREATE (a:X {prop: 42}), (:X)
query
      MATCH (n:X)
      RETURN n, n.prop iS NuLl AS b
expect bag
      | n               | b     |
      | (:X {prop: 42}) | false |
      | (:X)            | true  |
side-effects none
